name: ozon-v2-ops-controller
description: Ozon V2 controller for verified collection, intelligent field drafting, and evidence-locked image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Verified Ozon fields and image workbench.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates Ozon V2 collection, evidence-backed field drafting, real supplier SKU selection, and resumable image generation through a dynamic pool of up to five subagents as one per-product workflow with upload and publish gates.
defaultPrompt: Start a deduped seed-gated Ozon V2 run.
Use $ozon-intelligent-field-drafter to complete evidence-backed product fields for an Ozon V2 batch.
Use $ozon-image-generation-controller to process the verified image queue for an Ozon V2 batch.
Process the next verified Ozon image job.
